description: A scripted run through the test_movement course reaches the finish: stairs, two ramps, a jump over the gap, a drop, and a jump up the ledge. Jump times were estimated from the movement constants (top speed 320, a full-speed jump covers about 216 units) and passed unchanged on the first web run: takeoffs at x = 1349.6 for the gap and 1973.6 for the ledge.

expect.note: Cleared the gap: standing on the landing platform (64 + 24 = 88). Takeoff must happen with the origin between about x = 1290 and 1392.
On the finish ledge (32 + 24 = 56). Takeoff for the ledge jump must happen with the origin between about x = 1897 and 2015.
